name: Siouxsie Q
summary: Siouxsie Q is an American journalist, pornographic film actress, and sex workers' rights activist who identifies herself as a feminist and sex worker. She is a podcaster, singer/songwriter and playwright as well as a widely read columnist with SF Weekly.
